no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per Enzon 10-K (filed 2026-03-02), the Company has had no clinical operations and only limited corporate operations for more than ten years and is positioned as a public-company acquisition vehicle. Has no employees. Vicineum license was canceled by Amgen in 2025; PegIntron and other historical royalty patents have expired. On Feb 11, 2026 stockholders approved a merger with Viskase Companies (food packaging/cellulose casings); upon closing the company will rename to Viskase Holdings, Inc. — fully outside the pharma sector.
excluded_legacy_terminated: All historical Enzon-sponsored ctgov trials (Vicineum, Oncaspar, PEG-SN38, PEG-PARP, etc.) — completed/terminated/withdrawn; no active company-sponsored trials remain
